findings.note: Round-3 harness update: the round-2 contract (refuse ALL terminating workloads) was deliberately reverted by commit 9b6c83eb after the cleanup-skip mechanism was identified. New contract: RBG-owned terminating workloads stay claimable. Bites-check: this test is red on feb77ba7, green on 9b6c83eb. Prior test name: TestZZVerifyTerminatingWorkloadNotClaimed.

findings.note: Premise guard added in round 3: after 9b6c83eb dropped the blanket terminating check, the foreign-uid check is the only thing refusing a TERMINATING stale-uid leftover. Red on base, green on feb77ba7 and 9b6c83eb.

Residual gap after 9b6c83eb (review finding F5): any persistent reconcileRoles error (unlabeled orphan, foreign uid until GC, unmet dependency) still skips the step-9 cleanup, so a removed role's leftover leaks for the whole wedge. Canary asserts CURRENT behavior; flip it if the controller starts running cleanup on role-reconcile errors.
